newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Prosecutors arrest senior Russian general-Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors arrest senior Russian general-Interfax.

text.p: Russian military prosecutors on Wednesday issued an arrest warrant for army general Konstantin Kobets, a one-time aide to President Boris Yeltsin who is being charged with bribery, Interfax news agency said.

Interfax said Kobets, 57, sacked by Yeltsin as a deputy defence minister and expelled from the armed forces, had been taken to a Moscow detention centre for further investigation. The agency's report could not be confirmed immediately.

Kobets, who helped Yeltsin win armed confrontations with hardline opponents in 1991 and 1993, has been charged with illegal dealings with commercial firms, embezzlement and illegal posession of arms. He has denied all the charges.
Russian news agencies said Kobets, who had spent several days in hospital after suffering a mild heart attack, had been taken for questioning early on Wednesday. He was later arrested.
"He has been arrested but I am not sure whether he has already reached Moscow's Lefortovo prison," a spokesman for the military prosecutor's office said by telephone.

Yeltsin launched a new anti-corruption campaign, vowing to use tough measures to eradicate Russia's age-old scourge. He has also committed himself to putting long-delayed military reforms into action.
